verdict.rationale: Paperspace's official docs live on docs.digitalocean.com, and a probe confirms an llms.txt there (HTTP 200). That file is a DigitalOcean-wide index, though, and nothing shows it covers Paperspace content specifically. The per-page markdown variant for the Paperspace docs returned 404, so agent-oriented page formats are absent. Missing for 10: confirmed Paperspace-specific entries in llms.txt, markdown/agent-friendly doc pages, and any hands-on report of agents consuming these docs.
